November Giveaway #2: iTeaworld’s Workday Chinese Tea Collection

Posted on November 10, 2026 / 12 Comments

Destination Tea’s “10 Months of Giveaways”: November Prize #2

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:03
Instaread

To celebrate our 10th Birthday, Destination Tea is giving back to the tea community, with monthly gifts from March through December. For our second November giveaway, iTeaworld offers its Workday Chinese Tea Collection, making it easy to enjoy authentic Chinese loose-leaf tea, even on your busiest days. They have recently opened a U.S. warehouse so Americans have the option for domestic shipping of popular teas.

iTeaworld’s team has worked in the tea industry in China for 15 years. In 2018, they collected, treated, and transplanted more than 3,000 tea trees (more than 100 years old) and made sustainable protection plans for those trees, forming the Old Tree Ecological Tea Garden. The company now owns more than 4 million square meters of wild tea trees, and sources their teas from diverse regions across China. Their focus is on sharing Chinese tea culture around the world, offering affordable high mountain and wild old tree teas, with an emphasis on organic farming and sustainable packaging.

iTeaworld’s BLACK FRIDAY SALE: 20–25% off select products and
50% off 2026 green teas on iTeaworld.com

One winner wins:  Workday Chinese Tea Collection (36 corn fiber, food grade tea bags – 12 of each tea).

Unlike conventional tea bags filled with finely broken tea leaves, this collection uses quality loose-leaf teas packed into convenient, ready-to-brew sachets. No special teaware or complicated brewing process is needed — just add hot water and enjoy.

The collection includes three teas for different moments of the day:

  • Morning Jasmine Piaoxue: A bright, refreshing green tea traditionally scented with jasmine blossoms. Its fresh floral aroma makes it a lovely way to start the morning or enjoy an afternoon pick-me-up.
  • Midday 2014 Aged Shoumei: A mellow, smooth aged white tea with gentle sweetness. It’s ideal for relaxed afternoon sipping and can be steeped multiple times.
  • Evening Chinese Sweet Tea: A naturally caffeine-free botanical tea with a pleasant, natural sweetness, perfect for winding down in the evening.

Each sachet can be brewed more than once, making the collection both convenient and enjoyable throughout the day. Whether at work, at home, or on the go, it’s an easy way to enjoy the flavors of Chinese tea without setting aside time for a traditional gongfu tea session.

iTeaworld’s BLACK FRIDAY SALE: 20–25% off select products and
50% off 2026 green teas on iTeaworld.com

Giveaway Rules

ENTRY PERIOD:  November 10, 2026, 10 am to November 17, 2026, 10 am (EST)

HOW TO ENTER: No purchase necessary. Enter the giveaway by completing these 2 steps:

  1. Visit iTeaworld.com and explore their tea collections.
  2. Leave a comment on this post telling us: Which iTeaworld product would you love to try?

WINNER ANNOUNCEMENT:  Destination Tea will select one winner from the comments section on this post after contest ends.

Receipt of the prize by the Winner is upon the condition of compliance with any and all federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
